abilities.name: Hellblaster Focus
abilities.text: When you make an attack with a PLASMA weapon, you may re-roll up to Double Rank dice.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you ignore any impurities in your Chapter Gene-Seed, and also gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: The Flesh Is Weak
abilities.text: Iron Hands draw strength and surety by purging weakness from their forms. Choose one Augmetic Enhancement (p.242). You do not suffer the penalties of being Wounded (p.193). You gain +1 bonus die to Willpower Tests for every augmetic you have. His augmetic is an Augmetic Eye (Reticule), so +1 die to Willpower Tests.

abilities.name: Ruthless Logic (Tradition)
abilities.text: Suppressing all emotion and developing an unfeeling logic, their meticulous and apathetic nature make them cold allies to all but the Adeptus Mechanicus. You suffer a +2 DN penalty to Fellowship-based Tests made against a target that does not have the IRON HANDS or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS Keywords. This is a Tradition, not Gene-seed, so it applies, including with his kill-team brothers.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Cunning (+1 Determination); Accomplishment Cleanse and Purge (+1 Max Shock); Goal Advancement (+1 Influence).

talents.name: Deadshot
talents.text: You are a skilled shot, trained to carefully target your enemies' weak points. When you take the Aim action (p.189) and make a Called Shot (p.187) you double the bonus ED you receive.

talents.name: Duty Until Death
talents.text: Whenever you suffer more Wounds than your Max Wounds, you can use this Talent. You may take your next Turn normally; you begin Dying at the end of that Turn. You may choose to take your next Turn immediately after activating this Talent, potentially interrupting an enemy's Turn. If you roll a Complication on any Test, you take a Traumatic Wound.

gear: Augmetic Eye, Reticule (The Flesh Is Weak, Core p.243): +1 bonus die to ranged Attack Tests
Backpack ammunition supply for the Heavy Plasma Incinerator (Apocrypha p.352), as an Ammo Backpack (Core p.229): carry 10 more Ammo; came stocked with 3 (in the Plasma count)
Dragonfire Bolt rounds (Spread; ignores Defence bonuses from cover, Core p.230; BOLT weapons only)

detail.personality: More augmetic than flesh, he reports his own wounds as percentages and treats the incinerator's overheating as a flaw he is personally correcting.

objectives.text: Chapter: recover one intact archeotech device.
Secret: deliver it to the Magos, not the Inquisitor.
